text: Bomboma is an endangered indigenous language of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It belongs to the Niger-Congo language family. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people.

title: Bomboma language
text: Bomboma is a Bantu language of the Niger-Congo family, classified under Guthrie zone C31c within the Ngiri subgroup, spoken primarily by communities in the Equateur region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, along the Ubangi and Congo rivers near their confluence.
